data.name: Suhaan
data.gender_notes: Suhaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Suhaan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’, which means good, and ‘haan’, which means prosperous or fortunate. The name is thus a combination of the two, signifying a person who is blessed with good fortune and prosperity. The name Suhaan carries the meaning “Good, prosperous, fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Suhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody good, prosperous, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Suhaan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, prosperous, fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suhaan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
